/-- Auxiliary definition for the order on `WithBot`. -/
@[mk_iff le_def_aux]
protected inductive LE : WithBot α → WithBot α → Prop
  | protected bot_le (x : WithBot α) : WithBot.LE ⊥ x
  | protected coe_le_coe {a b : α} : a ≤ b → WithBot.LE a b
